title: LIFT ON, STRUGGLER! (Anti-Demoralization Battle Cry by Guts)
summary: Short motivational monologue in a Berserk/Guts style urging the viewer to embrace adversity and struggle. Modern comfort has removed the 'tiger' we evolved to face, and each person has to choose between being a zombie and being a warrior.
claims: Suffering is the only constant of existence; any relief is a temporary respite before the next storm
Stop seeing adversity as the enemy; it is momentum that carries you forward if you overcome it
Someone afraid to lose his life does not really live; you must seek out the tiger and attack it when it looks too strong
Modern life has removed the predator and the difficulty we evolved to overcome, leaving people staring at a meaningless existence
You are both the zombie and the warrior; choose struggle as your religion, and the hardest part, the first step, is behind you
